tagline.en: Estonian +372 native number eSIM — zero monthly fee, keep-alive via balance activity
tagline.zh: 爱沙尼亚+372原生号码eSIM：零月租，余额保号

description.en: eSIM.GG sells prepaid Estonian +372 native-number eSIMs usable across 154+ countries for SMS verification, calls and data. Official prices (2026-09): number €2.99; global bundles from €0.88/GB; €9 for 10GB across 42 countries (incl. China, US, UK, EU, Malaysia, Thailand). Incoming SMS free worldwide; China data €4.7/GB. Under current policy, qualifying activity (data/call/SMS/recharge) resets a 365-day activity window; the provider has announced an upcoming change to balance-based keep-alive.
description.zh: eSIM.GG 出售爱沙尼亚 +372 原生号码 eSIM，可在 154+ 国家用于接码、通话和数据。官方价（2026-09）：号码 2.99 欧；全球流量 0.88 欧/GB 起；42 国通用 10GB 仅 9 欧（含中国、美英欧、马来、泰国）。全球免费接收短信；中国数据 4.7 欧/GB。现行规则为「任意有效活动（流量/通话/短信/充值）重置 365 天活跃期」；官方已预告将改为「余额变动保号」。

details.en:
eSIM.GG (with data-only sister product eSIM.TF) is aimed at people who need a foreign number for platform registration and verification SMS: prepaid Estonian +372 number with no monthly fee, free incoming SMS worldwide, and pay-as-you-go rates that vary by country.

Official facts (verified 2026-09-26, esim.gg): number €2.99; data from €0.88/GB in Europe and most of Asia; headline bundle €9 for 10GB across 42 countries including China, US, UK, EU, Malaysia and Thailand; China data €4.7/GB, China incoming SMS free (outgoing €0.24); world map lists 145 covered +35 discontinued countries. Homepage states ChatGPT and TikTok work freely.

Keep-alive: current FAQ says qualifying activity (data, a call, SMS, or a recharge) resets the 365-day activity period; a line with no activity for 365 days may be released. The operator and resellers have announced an upcoming switch to balance-based keep-alive (a balance change each 365-day cycle maintains the number) — not yet in the official FAQ at check time, so expect this rule to move.

Acquisition: official site self-purchase includes €1 prepaid balance (code SETUP gives €0.40 off at the official store per reseller listing); a third-party reseller (shop.setup0.de, verified 2026-09-26: $3.43 listed, promo €2.99) sells codes with €0.5 prepaid and self-service number selection at esimgg.setup0.de. Reseller channels are unofficial — treat prices/promos as their own marketing. Phone must be carrier-unlocked and eSIM-capable; profile deletion must use native eSIM settings (not STK) or a paid QR replacement may be needed.
details.zh:
eSIM.GG（另有纯数据副牌 eSIM.TF）主打「要一个境外号码收验证码」的场景：爱沙尼亚 +372 预付费号码、零月租、全球免费接收短信、按量计费随国家浮动。

官方事实（2026-09-26 于 esim.gg 核验）：号码 2.99 欧；欧洲与亚洲大部流量 0.88 欧/GB 起；主打包 42 国通用 10GB 仅 9 欧（含中国、美、英、欧盟、马来西亚、泰国）；中国数据 4.7 欧/GB、来短信免费（发短信 0.24 欧）；世界地图口径 145 国覆盖+35 国已停。官网自述 ChatGPT 与 TikTok 可自由使用。

保号规则：现行 FAQ 口径为「有效活动（流量/通话/短信/充值）重置 365 天活跃期，365 天无活动可能被回收」；官方与渠道商已预告即将改为「余额变动保号」（每 365 天周期内产生一次有效余额变动即续期）——核验时官方 FAQ 尚未更新该条，规则落地以官方为准。

购买：官网自购自带 1 欧预存（渠道商口径：官网结账用码 SETUP 立减 0.4 欧）；第三方渠道 shop.setup0.de（2026-09-26 核验：挂价 $3.43、内测价 2.99 欧）卖兑换码、自带 0.5 欧预存、在 esimgg.setup0.de 自助选号。渠道价与促销属渠道自行营销，非官方口径。手机须为无锁 eSIM 机型；删除配置文件必须走系统原生 eSIM 设置（勿用 STK 删除，否则可能需付费补发二维码）。
